text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —It's retirement!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"As of today, I, Jungle Pocket, am 
stepping down from the position of 
'L/Roars' leader!"

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I'll never forget it. That day—I decided 
to step down as the head of the 
street-racing team.)

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Why, Pokke-san?! Isn't this the team you 
created?!

text_block_list.name: Lip-Pierced Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Pokke-san, does the owner... Does the 
owner know about this?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've already talked to them about 
it.

text_block_list.name: Team Owner
text_block_list.text: I heard last night. But Pokke……

text_block_list.name: Team Owner
text_block_list.text:
"Did you tell the other caretaker— that 
guy in Hokkaido?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No... not yet... But I intend to do things 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Team Owner
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Then I'll put in a brief 
word.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: —!? Owner.

text_block_list.name: Team Owner
text_block_list.text:
However, since you're stepping down, don't 
do things half-heartedly. In your new 
place, show a run that'll make them 
acknowledge you.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, looking back, from the very first 
time I came to this place until now—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so this is the hangout spot for the 
craziest bastards in Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm Jungle Pocket. Nice to meet ya. Now 
then――"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Let's settle who's head honcho right off 
the bat! Who's the fastest in this turf?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!! Tokyo is ours!! We're number one! 
ORAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Wolf-Cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We did it...! You did it, Pokke-san! I'm 
so glad I believed in you and followed 
you!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you bastards. Our fight doesn't end 
here. Next time—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
National conquest! We'll strike out from 
Tokyo!

text_block_list.name: L/Roars Member
text_block_list.text: OOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I've run single-mindedly, completely 
absorbed in it. Believing the pinnacle of 
strength lay at the end of this road. 
But—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki cruises to a comfortable 
victory in the Yayoi Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"That makes it four wins out of four! An 
unbelievable display of power! The Classic 
Triple Crown may now be well within 
reach!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa... She was in a dire spot, but then 
she blew right past them in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I thought the Twinkle Series was just a 
playground for stuck-up snobs. But this 
girl...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I wanna... I wanna run like that person 
too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(My eyes have been opened. The true 
pinnacle is right here. In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right here, today, I'm stepping down as 
head. However—I ain't giving up on my 
ambition.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you the power of the 'Demon of 
Roaring Battles.' This time on the grand 
stage, the Twinkle Series!

“—From today on, the days of taking on the 
Twinkle Series together with Jungle Pocket 
begin.”

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yo, partner. It's finally time.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Let's make some serious noise out there. 
I'll run for Fuji-san too. And you—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: For Bro's sake too. Right?

Fuji Kiseki was said to be a shoo-in for 
the Classic Triple Crown. My older brother 
was the one in charge of her medical care.

However, an unexpected injury turned the 
Triple Crown into an illusion. My brother 
tasted the very same bitter regret as Fuji 
Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I aim to be the strongest. And as proof 
of that, I'll run the Classic Triple 
Crown—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Avenging Fuji-san and your big bro's 
regrets... Man, this gets me seriously 
pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san doesn't show it on the surface, 
but... deep down, there must be a bitter 
pain locked away.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Let's give shape to that ourselves. With 
a run that won't lose to Fuji-san—no, one 
that surpasses her!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. But who did you say was going 
to surpass whom?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Fuji-san?! When did you get behind 
me...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just a little surprise. You're as 
full of spirit as always, I see. And—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see, you must be Pokke's Trainer.
choice_data_list: Hey there! Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. Please take good care of Pokke. 
She's someone I've watched over dearly for 
a long time, but from here on out, I'm 
entrusting her to you.

This Umamusume is Fuji Kiseki. A dashing, 
prince-like entertainer and the genius 
Jungle Pocket looks up to.

She also serves as the Ritto Dormitory 
Head at Tracen Academy and is beloved by 
many Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san, I'm gonna do it! For your sake 
too, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
If I win, it's pretty much the same as 
Fuji-san winning!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ain't no Umamusume who's learned more 
straight from Fuji-san than me."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
True, no one was ever as enthusiastic as 
you. I was surprised at first, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
She comes by every single day pleading, 
'Please, I beg of you.' With enough 
momentum to throw herself into a dogeza.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
At first, I wondered why you were so 
obsessed with me. But...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
As I coached you, I quickly realized that 
your passion for racing and your 
admiration for my running were the real 
deal.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I conveyed everything I 
possibly could. Everything at my disposal, 
that is."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, the Twinkle Series isn't so easy 
that you can win with just that alone."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, Pocket. In your 
generation, that Umamusume is there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I know. That's right, among my generation, 
there's her—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: That "Agnes Tachyon" is here.

"Agnes Tachyon. A mad scientist whose 
hobby is shady experiments, but..."

In a race, she runs as fast as particles 
of light. At this stage, she is the 
Umamusume said to be closest to the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Her running is insane... But because 
she's so completely out there, it actually 
makes things easier for me."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: As long as I defeat Tachyon—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That'll make me the strongest of our 
class!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haha, yeah. You could say that too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Pokke. On you... and 
on all of you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I really want you all to see it. The 
"continuation of the dream" that I was 
never able to see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's do this, Trainer!

Of course, Agnes Tachyon is a formidable 
opponent. However, there are other rivals 
who cannot be underestimated either.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text: Heh... Don't get cocky, Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Tsuzuki Reigning
text_block_list.text:
"Agnes Tachyon isn't your only opponent. 
I, Tsuzuku Rayning, will teach you that 
lesson!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san's painful past... I'll blow it 
completely away! And then—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Tachyon! I'm the strongest 
one here. WOOOOOH!"

"A rallying roar echoing into the blue 
sky. On that day—"

A lone beast aiming to be the strongest 
has been unleashed upon the fields of the 
Twinkle Series.
